Package com.codeup.novabook.repo.impl

Class UserRepositoryImpl

java.lang.Object
com.codeup.novabook.repo.impl.UserRepositoryImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
IGeneralRepository<User,Integer>, IUserRepository
public class UserRepositoryImpl extends Object implements IUserRepository
JDBC implementation of the IUserRepository interface using JdbcTemplateLight.

This implementation uses JdbcTemplateLight to simplify database operations, eliminate repetitive connection management, and provide clean transaction support.
